1.why: The interface uses a clean sans-serif typeface with clear letter and line spacing across all screenshots.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case with no italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks.

3.why: Content is presented in a single-column card layout that fits and remains readable at mobile width.

4.why: All instructions are brief and use plain, everyday language.

5.why: Example values are pre-filled in the email and mobile fields with a note to use the displayed details.

6.why: No long blocks of text are present; the user can proceed without reading lengthy content.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are displayed in any step, so copy support cannot be confirmed and is not present.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears in any screenshot.

9.why: Standard email and tel inputs are used that typically allow browser autofill, but no password or code fields and no explicit password-manager support are shown.

10.why: STEP 1 OF 5 label and the prominent blue Continue securely button clearly indicate the current step and primary action.

11.why: Only a single main action (Continue securely) is presented at a time.

12.why: After submit an error appears, but the system does not plainly state what happened next or how to proceed beyond remaining on the same form.

13.why: The form can be retried without apparent penalty, yet no codes exist to reveal, hide, or re-request.

14.why: The error 'Unable to sign in with those details' states a problem but offers no fix guidance and mildly implies user fault.

15.why: No time limits are shown or mentioned for reading or entry on any screen.
